instrument: teacher-forced raw logits from revision-pinned pretrained base causal language models
construct: Within-model association between a controlled hotel-role prompt and a researcher-frozen skill phrase, compared across publisher-documented pretraining cutoffs.
unit_of_observation: model_revision x role x skill_phrase x controlled_prompt_unit x geography_stratum x scoring_method
required_interpretation: Models are time-indexed statistical instruments. Reported quantities concern associations encoded by the frozen checkpoints under a fixed design.
forbidden_interpretations: measurement of employees or worker capabilities
measurement of vacancies or job advertisements
causal effect of calendar time or training-data freshness
design_warning: A cutoff is an upper freshness boundary, not a complete corpus date distribution. Model-version differences can reflect corpus composition, optimization, architecture details, or other training choices and cannot be attributed to time alone.
